messages:
maria (customer-sec): Hey team — ACME sent the security questionnaire back. Main asks: KMS integration details (CMEK/HSM), RBAC change audit trail, and incident response contact/SLAs. They want evidence by EOD tomorrow. Can we triage?
elaine (eng-security): I can take KMS + audit logging. Quick note: for Private customers we support customer-managed keys via Cloud KMS/HSM (CMEK) and we have HSM-backed BYOK options.
elaine (eng-security): For the questionnaire we should include key policy template + rotation cadence + where key material is stored (no key material stored in Redwood control plane).
tom (solutions): I'll draft the customer-facing language for the questionnaire. Need a short snippet for RBAC changes: who approves, how it's recorded.
raj (eng-ml): Any impact on model weights or inference artifacts? we only reference encrypted model checkpoint storage for private deployments. Not relevant to hosted API.
elaine (eng-security): Right — for hosted we use service-level keys; for Dedicated/Private we support CMEK. Add that keys are used for at-rest encryption for S3/GCS volumes and for disk encryption on VMs.
elaine (eng-security): Audit logging: we emit admin / policy / RBAC events to our immutable audit pipeline (stack: Kafka -> WORM S3 archive). Logs include actor, action, target, before/after and request_id. Retention depends on plan; enterprise customers get configurable retention + scooped exports.
elaine (eng-security): Example audit entry we can paste into the questionnaire:
```json
{
  "timestamp": "2025-03-12T14:22:11Z",
  "actor": "alice.redwood@redwood.ai",
  "action": "rbac.policy.update",
  "target": "role:dedicated-gpu-admin",
  "details": "added: role:network-admin",
  "request_id": "req_01G8XYZ",
  "outcome": "success"
}
```
maria (customer-sec): Perfect, they also asked about real-time alerting for suspicious RBAC changes and integration with their SIEM (Splunk).
elaine (eng-security): We emit a webhook + syslog/generic forwarder. We also ship a Splunk HEC example and can provide a sample alert rule. Re: suspicious changes — we have a configable anomaly detector that flags high-risk grants (external principal, wide-scoped role) and creates an incident ticket automatically.
tom (solutions): I'll attach the Splunk HEC config and a short how-to. Also need the on-call contact and incident SLA wording.
elaine (eng-security): Incident response: our standard enterprise SLA: P1 ack <15m, P1 mitigations in-progress within 1h; we provide 24/7 on-call for Dedicated/Private. For hosted customers we offer paid IR on retainer. We can redact phone numbers in the questionnaire and provide them after handshake.
raj (eng-ml): There's also a note about vulnerability triage: customer asked how we handle CVE disclosures for runtime libs used in the serving stack. We do CVE intake -> triage -> patch/workaround -> deploy with rollback plan. We can include MTTR metrics (median patch time for high severity over last 12 months).
elaine (eng-security): Action items: 1) I'll assemble KMS + audit log examples (ETA: 3pm PT). 2) Tom will draft customer-facing language + SIEM appendix (ETA: 5pm). 3) Raj will pull last-12m vuln triage metrics and a sanitized example postmortem (ETA: EOD).
maria (customer-sec): Thanks — can we do a 20m call at 3:15 to review the final wording before sending? @elaine @tom @raj
elaine (eng-security): Yep, I'll be there.
tom (solutions): 3:15 works for me.
raj (eng-ml): I'm in.
infra-bot: Deploy bot: created temp artifact for questionnaire attachments: s3://redwood-prod-audit-examples/1819004321-attachments.tar.gz
maria (customer-sec): Great — I'll hold the EOD deadline until after the call. :thumbsup:
elaine (eng-security): One more note for the questionnaire: include our key rotation policy (90 days for CMK rotation, support for custom rotation schedules). Also note KMS access audits are part of the exported logs.
maria (customer-sec): Awesome, thanks team. Will ping after the call with any last-minute items. :white_check_mark:
